sources.snippet: This is the recommended 0.6B model of the family. A fine-tune of NVIDIA's nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b for the caller side of 8 kHz US English telephone calls: fine-tune with layer-wise learning-rate decay 0.9, blended 0.8 / 0.2 with the base.
